ports.note: Takes nothing and fetches nothing: it chooses where data will come from. Emits a satellite-product, its own port type, because a catalog search without a chosen product searches nothing.

ontology.note: The receipt states the route chosen and what was and was not read about it: what it measures, whether it is an observation or a model, sign-in, and the licence as read with where and when, or that it is unread. Held by fw:SatelliteProductChoiceShape. The routes are curated in JLT's EO Satellite Guide, whose eo: vocabulary is vendored in examples/eo and not yet loaded into the ontology; the dataset citation read, with its DOI, the files it covers and where and when it was read, or fw:citationUnread.

changes.description: Each product carries the dataset citation its producer asks for, with the DOI for the processor version and where and when it was read; the receipt states it as fw:citationRead, or fw:citationUnread where nobody has read one. The three Sentinel-5P products on Planetary Computer carry ESA's Version 02 citations. Experiment 179.

evidence.note: The facts on each card were read in experiment 179's side experiments S3 to S8; a fact nobody read is shown as not read. Nothing here establishes that a product suits a health question, that its files hold data for a given place and date, or any citation: dataset citations are unread for every route.
